scope: An extensible catalog, not an exhaustive enumeration of every possible architecture.

embodiments.title: In-process native Loops
embodiments.benefit: Minimum placement overhead; no process isolation.
embodiments.limitations: Trusted deterministic workloads only. Model-quality comparison remains a separate qualification.

embodiments.title: One process per packet
embodiments.benefit: Fresh process state and isolated worker lifetime.
embodiments.limitations: Python worker protocol today, not an OpenCode or OS-security qualification.

embodiments.title: One long-lived worker session
embodiments.benefit: Startup is amortized; every packet still creates a fresh Loop and explicit state.
embodiments.limitations: A process restart loses in-flight work; no provider caching benefit is claimed.

embodiments.title: Bounded pool of worker sessions
embodiments.benefit: Independent requests can overlap while each pipe is serialized.
embodiments.limitations: Pool capacity is explicit; failures and queue time remain part of the result.

embodiments.title: Parallel verified candidate portfolio
embodiments.benefit: Two independent implementations are checked as they finish; each accepted candidate extends a versioned portfolio.
embodiments.limitations: This tests orchestration on trusted operations, not diverse-model success probability.

embodiments.title: Durable reactive activation
embodiments.benefit: Canonical SQLite scheduling, fencing, worker execution and persisted Run History.
embodiments.limitations: Pure deterministic activations only; external-effect resume needs additional qualification.

embodiments.title: Adaptive decomposition
embodiments.benefit: Attempt first, then select a contract-bound decomposition after verified failure.
embodiments.limitations: Not connected to this lab yet; use the existing PoC only as design evidence.

embodiments.title: Governed reuse first
embodiments.benefit: Resolve exact reviewed assets before generating a new implementation.
embodiments.limitations: The lab does not yet integrate capability qualification and promotion; no cache is presented as learned code reuse.

embodiments.title: OpenCode per action Loop
embodiments.benefit: Tool-using agency inside an exact isolated harness profile.
embodiments.limitations: The raw packaged adapter stays quarantined. Implement through a qualified host/harness binding.

embodiments.title: Container per action with brokered models
embodiments.benefit: Pinned execution environment and host-owned provider authority.
embodiments.limitations: Writable profiles, image availability and cancellation must be qualified before activation.

embodiments.title: Local agent under a governed host
embodiments.benefit: Retain vigil or TypeScript operator workflows with Loop Engine reasoning and acceptance.
embodiments.limitations: No repository merger or automatic publication. Needs an exact host adapter.

embodiments.title: Transactional semantic realization
embodiments.benefit: Interpret a versioned semantic contract, verify a candidate, then commit exact authorized effects.
embodiments.limitations: Existing core API foundation; no independently qualified lab runner yet.

embodiments.title: Provider-side speculative decoding
embodiments.benefit: Compare target/draft token verification beneath the model route.
embodiments.limitations: No local decoder implementation or qualified adapter was found. Hardware and sampling compatibility require testing.
